### If this pull request changes content

Content means corpus records in `corpora/`, or prose anywhere in the
repository.

- [ ] **Every factual claim I added or changed cites a source a reader can
      check.** Published books with page numbers, Navy documents, official
      histories, museum records. Not forum posts, not undated web pages, not
      unverified model output.
- [ ] I wrote this text myself. Nothing is pasted from a book, a placard, or
      another website.
- [ ] New FAQ records use a `faq_` or `fix_` id. A `der_` record is treated as
      an unreviewed draft and will never answer a visitor.
- [ ] I ran the question against a local instance and checked that my record is
      the one that answers.

### If this pull request changes code

- [ ] Public behaviour is unchanged, or the change is deliberate and described
      above.
- [ ] No secrets, local certificates, or environment-specific assumptions.
- [ ] Any environment variable or deployment setting affected is named above.
